articles.title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
articles.snippet: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

articles.title: What voters said about their views on crypto
articles.snippet: A CoinDesk-commissioned poll from April sheds light on how voters — who aren't necessarily part of the crypto sector — view this industry.

articles.title: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold
articles.snippet: Crypto executives expect US regulators to drive crypto policymaking regardless of the midterm election outcome.

articles.title: US midterms: Prediction markets favor Democrats in key crypto races
articles.snippet: Kalshi and Polymarket price a 75% chance of a Democratic sweep, days after markets misjudged Brazil’s runoff.

articles.title: Bitcoin price defends $76K lows as analysts see stocks pricing in ‘political gridlock’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin made modest gains at the start of Wall Street trading on Tuesday as markets awaited cues from the US midterm elections.
